disease_state.evidence: We conducted global proteome and phosphoproteome profiling of vehicle- and everolimus-treated tumors from 17 mice that were allografted with spontaneously developed mammary tumors from Brca1co/coMMTV-Cre mice using LC-MS/MS.

material_type.evidence: Frozen tissue samples were weighed and washed with cold Phosphate-Buffered Saline (PBS) to remove blood contamination, put into tissueTUBE (Covaris, Woburn, MA), snap-frozen in liquid nitrogen, and pulverized using cryoPREP Tissue Disruption system (CP02, Covaris, MA, USA).
